title: Milestone 6: 16x16 tiled raster
description: Implement the 16x16 tile grid, tile metadata/counter/offset buffers, primitive-to-tile binning, overflow policy, tile raster kernel, deterministic opaque ordering, and performance comparison against the minimal raster path.
close_reason: Completed: tiled 16x16 binning/raster path with bounded overflow telemetry and headless validation

title: Milestone 7: Depth color and HiZ policy
description: Choose and implement the MVP depth representation and opaque-world ordering policy, add validation for order disagreements, tile depth bounds, HiZ rejection, and a packed 64-bit atomic prototype for later entity paths.
close_reason: Completed: fixed depth-key ordering, depth validation mode, tile depth bounds, early-out, and packed depth/payload prototype

title: Milestone 5: Minimal world raster
description: Render recognizable opaque world surfaces in nooutput: setup visible world polygons, raster indexed output, sample texture and lightmap atlases, apply colormap rules, add depth, and expose visual debug modes.
close_reason: Completed: validated recognizable e1m1 nooutput dump through QrustyQuake adapter

title: Add quake_raster overlay API and device tests
description: Define a batched overlay triangle API for quake_raster and add device tests proving multi-pass depth preservation: far overlays are occluded by world depth, near overlays win, cutout texels do not write color/depth, and overlay misses leave unrelated pixels unchanged.
close_reason: Completed

title: Milestone 3: Resource model
description: Define renderer resource handles and tables for textures, lightmaps, surfaces, and worlds; add atlas storage/builders, upload/update APIs, and capacity telemetry.
close_reason: Completed persistent texture, lightmap, world resource tables, linear atlas uploads, surface metadata, telemetry, and headless resource tests.

title: Address second rasterizer review feedback
description: Fix follow-up review findings after final rasterizer review rerun: adapter resize/overflow/drop behavior, CI/device validation policy, ABI/layout documentation, tool smoke coverage, and public API/docs cleanup.
close_reason: Completed: addressed second review feedback with dynamic adapter visible storage, resize-preserving redraw, polygon/drop diagnostics, ABI/device validation docs, CI diff smoke and opt-in device job, kernel NaN depth guards, CMake compatibility checks, and API/docs cleanup

title: Validate and optimize GPU entity overlays
description: Add focused dumps or replay tests plus timedemo validation for entity overlays, then tune batching, tile capacity, deterministic depth ties, and performance once correctness is established.
close_reason: Accepted depth-tested CPU compositor fallback for Quake overlays; proper GPU overlay corruption remains tracked by libkfd-3qv.

title: Implement tiled GPU overlay raster pass
description: Add a dedicated overlay path that bins overlay-only triangles, seeds each pixel from existing world indexed/depth buffers, writes only covered nearer fragments, and supports alias textured, sprite cutout, and flat particle material modes without atomics or full-screen corruption.
close_reason: Completed

title: Fix quake_raster timedemo FOV mismatch
description: Investigate and fix the KFD qrustyquake adapter projection so compute-rasterized world geometry matches the software renderer field of view instead of appearing zoomed/narrow.
close_reason: Not a renderer bug: qrustyquake/id1/config.cfg currently sets fov to 10, so the KFD path is correctly showing the configured narrow field of view

title: Milestone 8: Present mode
description: Add a replaceable present backend interface, factor or reuse DMA-BUF/X11 present code, keep nooutput as the default test path, resolve to present surfaces, and add a display-guarded smoke test.
close_reason: Completed: QR_OUTPUT_PRESENT callback backend with indexed-to-XRGB resolve and headless present smoke test

title: Milestone 2: GPU kernel package
description: Add renderer-owned GPU kernel sources, CMake helpers for supported AMDGPU targets, kernel selection/load inside qr_context, GPU indexed clear, indexed-to-XRGB resolve, GPU-dispatch nooutput tests, and readback after GPU completion.
close_reason: Completed renderer-owned GPU kernel package with clear and XRGB resolve kernels plus headless validation.

title: Remove hot path GPU allocations
description: Preallocate transient quake_raster draw buffers at context creation so frame/draw paths do not create or destroy GPU buffers.
close_reason: Completed: preallocated transient world triangle buffer and replaced hot-path GPU allocation with QR_ERROR_NO_SPACE capacity check

title: Fix quake_raster texture warping near screen edges
description: Investigate and fix distorted compute-rasterized wall textures in qrustyquake timedemo mode, likely caused by incorrect projection, clipping, or perspective texture interpolation near screen edges.
close_reason: Completed: world raster kernel now perspective-corrects depth, texture coordinates, and lightmap coordinates using 1/z interpolation; added a device regression test for non-affine texture sampling

title: Improve quake_raster timedemo runs
description: Reduce timedemo overhead/noise by making clipped-surface diagnostics debug-only and adding a qrustyquake KFD cvar to skip the legacy software world draw when benchmarking the compute rasterizer.
close_reason: Completed: added qrustyquake qraster_skip_legacy_world timedemo toggle, made clipped-surface diagnostics debug-only, and rebuilt SDL/KFD binaries

title: Present quake_raster world in timedemo mode
description: When qrustyquake skips legacy world drawing for KFD timedemo comparisons, read the quake_raster indexed framebuffer into the visible Quake software buffer so walls are shown and entities can layer on top.
close_reason: Completed: qrustyquake skip-legacy timedemo mode now blits the quake_raster indexed world framebuffer into the active view buffer after legacy edge scan, preserving later entity draws

title: Address final rasterizer review feedback
description: Fix final multi-perspective review findings for quake_raster and QrustyQuake adapter: silent overflow/mismatch handling, validation artifacts, API comments, stale code, and diagnostics.
close_reason: Completed: addressed final rasterizer review feedback with adapter diagnostics/recreation, finite input validation, stale kernel cleanup, host CI validation, checked-in smoke artifacts, and stronger diff diagnostics

title: Milestone 1: Nooutput diagnostics
description: Add headless nooutput diagnostics: raw indexed dumps, resolved-output inspection, deterministic pattern tests, padded-stride readback tests, and undersized-buffer failure tests.
close_reason: Completed nooutput indexed dump, XRGB/PPM inspection, padded readback, and undersized-buffer validation.

title: Fix quake_raster world depth artifacts
description: Investigate and fix remaining KFD qrustyquake world rendering artifacts after perspective interpolation: misplaced-looking polygons and z-fighting/order errors in the compute raster output.
close_reason: Completed: world raster now resolves fixed-key depth ties using float depth, avoids equal-key HiZ early-outs, and includes a regression test where the nearest surface previously lost to submission order

title: Milestone 10: Entities
description: Add alias model resources and commands, alias triangle raster, sprites, particles, and packed-atomic or ordered-pass policies where world ordering no longer applies.
close_reason: Completed: alias model upload/draw, sprite draw, and particle draw paths reuse preallocated tiled triangle dispatch

title: Milestone 0: Finish renderer library skeleton
description: Complete the isolated C99 quake_raster skeleton: replace ad hoc calloc/free with renderer-owned allocation, add API versioning, structured error enum, and public API docs for ownership, threading, and frame lifetime.
close_reason: Completed API versioning, structured result codes, ownership/threading docs, and centralized host allocation helpers.

title: Fix quake_raster floor polygon artifacts
description: Investigate and fix remaining KFD qrustyquake world geometry artifacts where horizontal floor polygons appear to extend past their correct boundaries after depth tie fixes.
close_reason: Completed: world polygon submission now uses preallocated CPU ear-clipping scratch instead of triangle fans, preventing concave floor outlines from filling across voids; added a concave polygon raster regression

title: Gate legacy entity draws in KFD timedemo mode
description: The skip-legacy timedemo mode currently bypasses BSP world faces but still allows legacy alias models, brush entities, viewmodels, sprites, and particles to draw. Gate those software passes while the KFD world path is active so the mode is not mixed-renderer output.
close_reason: Completed: legacy brush entities, alias entities, viewmodel, particles, and alpha edge pass are skipped while the KFD skip-legacy timedemo mode is active

title: Milestone 4: QrustyQuake adapter layer
description: Add adapter code outside the renderer core to extract Quake textures, mip levels, surface metadata, lightmaps, and visible world surface commands while keeping the existing KFD/palette backend as fallback.
close_reason: Added QrustyQuake-side quake_raster adapter scaffold for resource extraction and visible world surface recording while preserving the existing KFD presentation fallback.

title: GPU overlay rendering for Quake entities
description: Replace the diagnostic CPU entity overlay with a proper libkfd quake_raster GPU overlay path that preserves the world color/depth buffers and renders alias models, sprites, particles, and brush entities without block corruption or through-wall artifacts.

title: Submit brush entities through transformed GPU overlay geometry
description: Render moving/rotating brush entities in the GPU path by submitting transformed or already-clipped brush polygons with correct texture/lightmap coordinates instead of relying on bare world surface indices.
close_reason: Completed

title: Fix quake_raster frustum clipping artifacts
description: Back out the concave polygon triangulation experiment and fix remaining qrustyquake KFD world artifacts by matching the software renderer's side/top/bottom frustum clipping before projection.
close_reason: Completed: backed out the concave polygon triangulation experiment and added qrustyquake adapter clipping against near, left, right, top, and bottom view-space frustum planes before projection

title: Move QrustyQuake aliases sprites and particles to GPU overlays
description: Replace the current CPU overlay composite in qrustyquake with the new quake_raster GPU overlay API while preserving CPU-side Quake semantics for alias frame/skin selection, seam handling, sprite clipping/cutouts, viewmodel depth bias, and particle simulation/size/color.
close_reason: Completed

title: Render Quake entities through quake_raster adapter
description: Wire QrustyQuake alias models, sprites, viewmodels, brush entities, and particles into the libkfd quake_raster entity APIs so skip-legacy KFD timedemo mode renders a complete scene without software entity passes.
close_reason: Implemented qrustyquake compute-side entity and particle rendering path

title: Milestone 11: Performance and validation
description: Add perf counters, deterministic timedemo/headless benchmark mode, image diff tooling, stress scenes, and a CI-friendly nooutput validation subset.
close_reason: Completed: perf counters, headless benchmark, image diff tool, stress/nooutput tests, and validation docs

title: Milestone 9: Classic surface types
description: Add classic Quake sky, water/turbulence, transparent/cutout handling, animated light styles, and dirty dynamic lightmap updates.
close_reason: Completed: sky, turbulence, cutout, and dirty lightmap update support with QrustyQuake adapter submission
